objects.description: Someone or something that acts — a person, or an agent standing in for one. The persona is the document beside it; only the few fields here mean the same in every domain.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "AC-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: What to call this actor on screen. The only name the domain promises to show.

fields.name: is_agentic
fields.description: True when the actor is an agent rather than a person, so a caller can tell a human seat from a machine one.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: The persona: everything a domain knows about this actor beyond its name. Queried in place by path, so a domain's own vocabulary never becomes a column here.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every listing.

indexes.name: attributes_phone
indexes.description: One actor per phone number. The database half of the duplicate-attribute refusal, so a write that races past the Go pre-check still fails.

indexes.name: attributes_email
indexes.description: One actor per email address, for the same reason the phone index exists.

objects.description: A node in the org structure — a department, a cohort, a team. Its parent decides where it sits and its level decides what it is called.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "G-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten by an edit.

fields.name: hierarchy_id
fields.description: The level tree this group belongs to. Fixed at creation — a group does not move between hierarchies.

fields.name: level_id
fields.description: The level this group sits at, which is what gives it its depth and its domain noun.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: The group directly above this one. Empty at the root, and never a group inside this one's own subtree.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The group's human-readable name, shown wherever the structure is drawn.

fields.name: discoverable
fields.description: True when an actor who is not already registered may find this group and ask to join.

fields.name: anchor_level_override_id
fields.description: The level that anchors this group's subtree, where it differs from the hierarchy's default anchor. Empty means the default applies.

fields.name: node_type
fields.description: The group type this group was created as, carried as a plain label rather than a reference.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Whatever the domain declares about a group beyond its name, queried in place by path.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every listing.

indexes.name: parent
indexes.description: Walks the structure one level down, which is what listing a group's children is.

indexes.name: hierarchy
indexes.description: Reads one hierarchy's whole structure without touching another's.

objects.description: One actor's registration in one group. The pair is the key, so an actor is registered in a group once or not at all.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The registered actor. Half of the key.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group registered in. The other half of the key.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Whatever the domain declares about a registration — when it started, what it is for — queried in place by path.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the registration was made. The only date a registration carries.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every listing.

indexes.name: group
indexes.description: Lists a group's roster, which is the read the structure screen makes per node.

objects.description: A kind of seat that can be held — chair, treasurer, delegate. Retiring one stops it being granted without disturbing the seats already held.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "RK-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the seat is called, in the domain's own words.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: The capability names this kind confers, as a JSON array. Never null on the way out — a kind created without any reads back as an empty list.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the seat is for, shown wherever a holder is chosen.

fields.name: is_delegate
fields.description: True when the seat stands in for another group rather than governing its own.

fields.name: level_id
fields.description: The level this kind may be granted at. Empty means any level.

fields.name: retired_at
fields.description: When the kind was retired. Empty means it is still grantable — this field is what Retired() reads.

fields.name: retired_by
fields.description: The actor who retired the kind. A domain fact, not audit dressing, which is why retiring takes an actor and unretiring does not.

indexes.name: level
indexes.description: Finds the kinds grantable at one level, which is what a grant form offers.

objects.description: One held seat: an actor holding a role kind in a group. Granted, then ended — revoked, resigned, evicted or departed — and never deleted, so the history of who held what survives.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key. A seat is granted, revoked and stepped down from by id, unlike a registration, which is keyed by its pair.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The actor holding the seat.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group the seat is held in.

fields.name: kind_id
fields.description: The kind of seat held.

fields.name: active
fields.description: True while the seat is held. An ended seat stays as a row with this false.

fields.name: granted_at
fields.description: When the seat was granted.

fields.name: granted_by
fields.description: The actor who granted it.

fields.name: ended_at
fields.description: When the seat stopped being held. Empty while it is still active.

fields.name: ended_reason
fields.description: Why the seat ended: taken away, given up, lost with the group seat, or lost with the registration.

indexes.name: actor
indexes.description: Lists every seat one actor holds, across groups.

indexes.name: group
indexes.description: Lists every seat held in one group, which is what the dashboard reads.

indexes.name: kind
indexes.description: Finds the live seats of one kind, which is what refuses the retirement of a kind still held.

objects.description: One named tree of levels. A domain may keep several — a governance tree and a delivery tree — and a group belongs to exactly one.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "H-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten by a rename.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the tree is called.

objects.description: One rung of a hierarchy: how deep it sits, and whether it is the rung a subtree anchors on.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "L-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten by a rename.

fields.name: hierarchy_id
fields.description: The tree this rung belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What this rung is called, which is the noun a group at it is shown under.

fields.name: depth
fields.description: How far down the tree this rung sits, counting from zero at the root.

fields.name: is_default_anchor
fields.description: True on the one rung per hierarchy that a subtree anchors on unless a group overrides it.

indexes.name: hierarchy
indexes.description: Reads one tree's rungs in order, which is every read of a hierarchy.

objects.description: The domain's own noun for the groups at one level — "chapter", "faculty", "squad" — in both its singular and plural spellings.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "GT-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten.

fields.name: hierarchy_id
fields.description: The tree this noun belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The type's own name, which is what a group carries as its node type.

fields.name: singular
fields.description: How to name one group of this type.

fields.name: plural
fields.description: How to name several.

fields.name: level_id
fields.description: The level this noun applies at. Empty means it applies anywhere in the tree.

indexes.name: hierarchy
indexes.description: Lists one tree's nouns, which is what a structure screen reads to label its nodes.

indexes.name: level
indexes.description: Finds the noun for one level, which is the lookup a group's label makes.

objects.description: One counter per coded type, holding the next number its code will take. Written by a compare-and-set so two concurrent creates cannot mint the same code.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: The type being counted — actor, group, hierarchy, level, role_kind, grouptype. One row each.

fields.name: next_number
fields.description: The number the next code of this type takes. Read and advanced in one conditional write.
